notes.title: Craftlands Workshoppe - Full Release Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello crafters,

We're excited to announce that Craftlands Workshoppe has now transitioned from Early Access to full release. We are grateful for all of your support and hope that you enjoy this update.

The update finishes up the story by adding the final quest line, and a number of bug fixes, including a fix for the barber quest popup displaying every time you load your game.

If you've been holding out until full release to play Craftlands Workshoppe, we've got a 10% off launch discount for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197820/Craftlands_Workshoppe/

Thank you all again for all of your support, feedback and bug reports over the Early Access period - it's been a joy shaping the game alongside you all.

[h1]v1.0 Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/7500daa64ce3372856f58183d760ee52ece9c1d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Selutarr Mansion[/b]
You can now enter Selutarr's mansion! You'll have to meet up with a mysterious wizard to trigger the final quest line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/490a834994c6ce5cfbabdd4ce76aca8cd14ab3b9.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Final Quest Line[/b]
Finish the story and open the portal to a new dimension. Reach 100% reputation with all freight destinations, gather lucifrite crystals and discover more about Timothy and their past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/4417b2f440521aae1f4c9bfd964138461da8b0b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Allcraft's Key[/b]
Craft Allcraft's magical key to open the portal
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/45f61f7657a7c73f2bb0da85736023770c29100d.jpg[/img]

[b]Portal Island[/b]
Visit the portal island, receive the final quest and open the portal. Gather the trade-masters and get ready for the final showdown.

notes.title: Craftlands Workshoppe Hits Full Release on 17 December
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We're happy to announce that Craftlands Workshoppe will hit full release on 17 December!

The v1.0 update will finish up the story by adding the final quest line. Of course the update will also include a number of bug fixes.

[h1]What's in the v1.0 Update?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/7500daa64ce3372856f58183d760ee52ece9c1d2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/490a834994c6ce5cfbabdd4ce76aca8cd14ab3b9.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Final Quest Line[/b]
Finish the story and open the portal to a new dimension. Reach 100% reputation with all freight destinations, gather lucifrite crystals and discover more about Timothy and their past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/4417b2f440521aae1f4c9bfd964138461da8b0b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Allcraft's Key[/b]
Craft Allcraft's magical key to open the portal
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/45f61f7657a7c73f2bb0da85736023770c29100d.jpg[/img]

[b]Portal Island[/b]
Visit the portal island, receive the final quest and open the portal. Gather the trade-masters and get ready for the final showdown.

If you're interested in the game but haven't yet picked it up, please do add it to your wishlist and check the game out at launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197820/Craftlands_Workshoppe/

[h1]Thank You[/h1]

We'd also like to say a big thank you to all of you who have joined us for this Early Access adventure. We are incredibly grateful for all of your support, feedback and bug reports. And we hope you will enjoy this v1.0 update on 17 December.

Thanks,
The Craftlands Workshoppe Team

notes.title: New Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello crafters!

We have just released an update for Craftlands Workshoppe! Read on for the full patch notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/0d61fe4a8d687579bd99eeb1458c30f892fe471a.png[/img]

[b]New![/b]
-You can reshuffle your workers level up skills to pick one that you like more, but take care each reshuffle will increase the cost of a reshuffle for that specific worker.
-The ability to check what goods characters sell from the map has been added
-Worker house can be upgraded to Level 3 increasing worker count to 10
-Hitting money cap emits gold coins as your movement dust
-Hitting gold cap miraculously fixes up Boogeys freight

[b]Changes[/b]
-Daily task board for Freights removed, replaced with a list of freight destination wanted item type list
-Fishing has been slowed down drastically
-Anoli challenge nerfed, requiring 3 goods to be delivered instead of 5

[b]Fixes[/b]
-Fixed map NPC's showing complete tasks as available
-Anglerico and Theodore appear on the map

Thank you so much for supporting us and playing Craftlands Workshoppe this year! We hope you all have a wonderful holiday season and a happy new year.

Hello crafters!

Thank you for the ongoing support for Craftlands Workshoppe. Today we have for you the second Early Access update. Lots of alterations and bug fixes. Read on for the details!

notes.title: Craftlands Workshoppe - Bug Fix Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Hello crafters!

It's now been just over a week since we launched and we continue to be delighted by the response so far and are listening to all of your feedback! Today I have the pleasure of announcing that the first ever Craftlands Workshoppe Early Access update is now live, with plenty of bug fixes. Read on for all the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/b73441586d3bb0fc42d3679558248df8430c17e8.jpg[/img]

Please note that while the game does not officially support any other languages than English this update allows you to translate the game yourself if you wish to.

You can locate the game text by doing the following:
 - Press the windows key + R on your keyboard to open the run console
 - type in %appdata%/../locallow/Arvydas Zemaitis/Craftlands Workshoppe/Languages

Then you can create your own language folder, duplicate the English text files and translate the words within them. Then, next time you boot up the game you will see a language select screen so you can select your translation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/6e0d96e42d3ad5f73bc464317b954525d5f09a9c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]New![/b]
 -Language select screen will now enable if more than one language is found within the language folder
-Steel is now a trade from Dick the orc for 50 Glass

[b]Changes[/b]
-Clicking the cancel button in the container UI filter section will auto remove any filter that was typed in
-Bubka vendor quantities buffed hard
-Continue button in the main menu is now green! Woo!
-Fresh new workers always have 1x carry
-Fresh workers lowest speed is 80% and highest is 130%
-Blueprints renamed to Templates as they are used up during crafting
-Assembler now uses 1 energy per tick instead of 2
- Charisma modifier now only works on customers when you are in the Shoppe
-Extra info panel in the top left corner is open by default, click the arrow to close
-Virtillo token request item list modified

[b]Fixes[/b]
-Freight loading fixes
-Money stat screen money counter auto sizes as not to go out of the border
-Another spell check done
-Main player UI Skill text now fits better into the frame
-Fridge properly asks for 60 items in his cutscene
-Container UI better fits more resolutions
-Keybindings now display arrow keys properly
-Fixed vendor delivery counts duplicating with the first delivery item
-UI should fit more extreme resolutions
-Proper rendering fix for creating panels in mods
-Intellect and Speed potion recipes properly flagged as "unpurchasable" by Timothy
-Purchased but unbuilt modular plot should now save, could cause issues with old saves resulting in loosing old bought plots...sorry
-Supplying 40 growables to a modular farm plot now properly saves
-Need a harness triggers fixed
-Workers should not check money chest once more money is added after work hours
-Valgi challenge should no longer request 2 customers at once
-Fridge count check done
-Longer hair mesh modified
-Worker XP is now properly saved and loaded
-Right clicking to exit no longer triggers interaction, unless you keep holding down RMB
-Resource money is properly saved/loaded

Work is underway on the next update, which will focus on balancing and other additional feedback.

notes.title: Release Date Brought FORWARD + Listen to the Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Hey crafters!

Craftlands Workshoppe is really not very far away from its Early Access launch. No, I mean really! We've brought the release date FORWARD by a couple days to Tuesday 13 October. After multiple community betas we are pleased to bring forward the release date. This means that Craftlands Workshoppe will be available at the end of the 2020 Steam Games Festival: Autumn Edition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/debf596e0aa4e78e75f56aea654cf8dd9df0a317.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]

We've also released two pieces of the Craftlands Workshoppe soundtrack, composed by Daniel Romeros! Cram these down your earholes to get in the Craftlands mood:

https://youtu.be/aCm1S7uXOLA https://youtu.be/CQvhDMFEayY

We're less than three weeks away from Early Access launch! By my calculations, that's less than 7560 listens of the main theme to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37382991/83d96f123997cc0888070e9cec3d6dd0df61ad6d.jpg[/img]

If you haven't already, please do add the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197820]game[/url][/b] to your wishlist.

Until next time, crafters!
